full_details: In the morning the loaf was still shrunk on the pan. You read a Rose bill at the lodging, title only, and you did not cross. At two you were in Two Gentlemen at the Theatre. The house was an ordinary playing-day house. Nobody emptied a box into a speech. You came home by the ordinary way. The three sheets were still on the board, and you added nothing. The prison was still unwritten. Before sleep you marked the full moon in the almanac, and no other mark.
one_sentence: You played Two Gentlemen to an ordinary house, and marked the full moon.
title: Two Gentlemen, and a full moon
